content.text: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod. My name is Marco. My name is Catherine and today we have a delicious lesson all about Chinese food for you.
content.trans: 你好，大家和欢迎来到英语课程。我的名字是马科，我叫凯特琳娜，今天我们将学习关于中国的美食知识给你。

content.text: That's right. Today we are ordering Chinese food. Now for many of you listeners that are actually Chinese, you may not recognize these dishes because we are talking about American Chinese food.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。今天我们正在订购中国的食物。现在对于很多您听众来说，可能不太熟悉这些菜肴，因为我们将谈论的是美国中文的食物。

content.text: That's right. So long, long ago people came over to America from mainly Hong Kong. And so a lot of the food we have is kind of more like Hong Kong food. Cantonese food. Cantonese food.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。所以，很久以前，人们从主要的香港搬到了美国。因此，我们有很多食物和菜肴像香港的食物一样。港式菜。

content.text: But it's also very American. So let's take a listen to today's dialogue and find out exactly what we're eating.
content.trans: 但是它也很美国。所以让我们听听今天的对话，找出我们正在吃的东西。

content.text: Hi, welcome to Happy Buddha. Can I get you anything to drink? Coke for me please. I'll have a sprite.
content.trans: 你好，欢迎来到幸福佛。我可以为你倒一杯可乐吗？请给我一罐 Sprite。

content.text: Okay, I'll go get that for you. Are there any questions with the menu? Do you use MSG? No, ma'am. We are MSG free.
content.trans: 好的，我将为您处理您的菜单。您是否需要使用MSG？是的，请告诉我。

content.text: Oh man, I haven't had Chinese food in so long I want everything. This place has the best sesame chicken.
content.trans: 啊，我真想吃正宗的中国菜了。这家店真是最好吃的！

content.text: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time. I used to get take out all the time. It's definitely been a while. Let's start off with some crab brain goon.
content.trans: 是的，我一直对中文情有独钟。我曾经经常去取快递。这么长时间了，真的挺久远的。我们先从一些杂货商开始。

content.text: Oh yeah, that sounds good. I think I'm going to get these sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll, and a drop soup.
content.trans: 嗯，听起来不错。我想我得把这些芝麻鸡、炒米饭、炸饼和炖汤都做好了。

content.text: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu. It all looks so appetizing. I think I'll get general toes chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wantons, and white rice.
content.trans: 这个点和拍是傻瓜相机。SLR/DSLR是单反相机。机身是体，镜头是镜，长焦是长焦，偏振镜是偏振镜。卸下重任是卸下重担。赋予神速是授予神速。一路顺风是疏远且微弱。松开手是卸任。辞职信是辞职信。入门级是入门级。显示屏是显示屏。套机镜头是机，Fluency Builder是流利构建单元。全球视野是全球视野。

content.text: I'm just supposed to be on a diet. You should at least get brown rice. I don't think so. I hate brown rice. And I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
content.trans: 我被要求减肥。你至少应该吃糙米。我不这么认为。我对糙米恨铁不成。而且，我讨厌每天都吃健康的食物。

content.text: I've been eating so much salad. I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like. There's no better remedy than some nice greasy calorie-laden Chinese food. I might even get in order of broccoli beef.
content.trans: 我一直在吃大量的沙拉。我保证我已经忘记了肉的味道了。没有什么比一些油腻的、高热量的中式食物更好的治疗方案了。我甚至可以和蔬菜、牛肉一起吃。

content.text: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry. Let's call the waitress over.
content.trans: 哎呀，我太饿了。让我们叫服务员过来。

content.text: All right, we're back. So obviously everything seems so good, very typical American Chinese dishes. And we have a lot of things that we can take a look at. So let's start with language takeaway.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经回来。很明显，一切都很好，非常典型的美国中式菜肴。而且我们可以看看很多东西。所以让我们从语言总结开始。

content.text: Language takeaway.
content.trans: 语言总结。

content.text: In language takeaway today, we're going to be talking about some general food words words that you can use when you're ordering foods. So the first one we should talk about is this MSG.
content.trans: 今天的话题是关于一些通用的食品词汇，当你在点餐时可以使用这些词。今天我们要讨论的是这个MSG。

content.text: Right, Andrea asks, do you use MSG? So why are you asking this and what is MSG?
content.trans: 英语：对，安德里亚问道，你用MSG吗？所以为什么问这个问题和MSG是什么的？

content.text: MSG is an ingredient in foods. It's kind of like a condiment, something that you put on the food after the food has been cooked.
content.trans: MSG 是食品中的一个重要成分。它有点像调味品，当你把食物煮熟后才加入的。

content.text: And it makes the food taste better, brighter. And intensifies the flavors a little bit.
content.trans: A、它使食物的味道更好，更亮。 以及稍微增强风味。

content.text: Yeah, and it looks like salt or sugar. It's on the tables usually at Chinese restaurants.
content.trans: 是的，而且看起来像盐或糖。通常在中餐馆里常看到它。

content.text: But a lot of people don't like MSG because they don't think it's very safe for their bodies. Right.
content.trans: 但是很多人不喜欢MSG，因为他们认为它对他们的身体不好。

content.text: And so actually the waitress says that the food is MSG free, which means there's no MSG in it.
content.trans: 所以实际上，服务员说食物是MSG-free，这意味着没有MSG在里面。

content.text: That's right. Okay. So she says our food is MSG free, which is this chemical. I think it's kind of like a chemical that you describe.
content.trans: 是的。明白了。她说我们的食物不含味精，这是一种化学物质。我认为这和你描述的类似。

content.text: That's right. And a lot of people don't want it. So you can ask, is this food MSG free? You can also ask, is it fat free?
content.trans: 是的，很多人都不想要它。所以你可以问我，这个食物是否含有MSG？你也可以问我，这个食品是否低脂？

content.text: Is it salt free? So this is a very helpful way of asking about what the ingredients are in a dish.
content.trans: 是吗？所以这是在询问食物中哪些成分。

content.text: That's right. That's right. And actually, Manny is talking about the food as well. He says, yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。事实上，曼尼正在谈论食物，他说，嗯，我一直对中餐有这么长时间的好奇心。

content.text: Okay. So the verb here is to crave, but he said he's been craving. So he really has been wanting this food for a long time.
content.trans: 好的。那么这个动词在这里是渴望，但他说他已经渴望很久了。所以他真的已经对这顿饭产生了浓厚的兴趣。

content.text: So if you say I'm craving Italian food, what does that mean?
content.trans: 所以如果你说我正渴望意大利美食，那意味着什么？

content.text: That means I really want to eat Italian food. You feel like having Italian food. That's right. So I'm craving some kind of food. I really want to eat it.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：

content.text: Okay. And he said that he used to get takeout all the time. So he's obviously talking about Chinese food. What does he mean by takeout?
content.trans: 好的。他以前经常点外卖，所以他显然是在谈论中国食物。他用什么来表示这一点呢？

content.text: Well, takeout is the opposite of sitting down in a restaurant in eating food. Takeout is what you do when you want to go home and eat it.
content.trans: 嗯，外卖是和在餐馆吃饭相反的。外卖就是当你想回家吃东西的时候做的事情。

content.text: So in many restaurants, you can order the food and then you go and you pick up the food and you bring it home.
content.trans: 所以，在许多餐厅，你可以点餐并自己去取餐，并且将食物带回家中。

content.text: Okay. So that's takeout. So it's a noun. You get takeout.
content.trans: 好的。那么这就是外卖。所以这是一个名词。你点外卖。

content.text: Right. But it's a little bit different from a different kind of takeout. There's takeout where you order the food and you pick it up and you bring it home.
content.trans: 正确。不过它与另一种类型的外卖有些不同。在你点餐后，你可以自己拿取并带回家中。

content.text: But there's also delivery and delivery is when you order the food and someone else brings it to you. So be careful with those two.
content.trans: 但是还有送货和送货，这是当你订购食物并有人将它送到你面前时。所以要小心这两个。

content.text: All right. Very good. And moving forward and moving forward, many kept talking about the food and said, wow, everything on the menu looks so appetizing. It all looks so appetizing.
content.trans: 好的，我来帮你翻译这个句子：

content.text: Okay. Appetizing is a way to describe something. In this case, we're describing food. So that's normally how we use the word appetizing. So appetizing basically means that you're excited about eating this food because it looks like it will be good.
content.trans: 好的。描述食物的方式有很多种，比如“美味”、“诱人”等。在这种情况中，我们通常使用“美味”这个词来描述食物。所以，“美味”在这里表示你对吃这个食物感到兴奋和期待。

content.text: So what about the word appetizer? Does this have anything to do with it?
content.trans: 英语：所以，关于这个单词“appetizer”，它和它有什么关系？

content.text: I think appetizer is something that makes you want to eat more. That's why it's at the beginning of a meal. You have your appetizer before you have your main course.
content.trans: 我倾向于认为，点心是让你想要吃更多的东西。这就是为什么它在一顿饭的开始就摆在你的面前。你先吃点心再吃主菜。

content.text: But the word appetizing means that it's very appealing. You really want to eat it. It looks good. It looks delicious.
content.trans: 但是，这个单词“appetizing”意味着它非常诱人。你真的想吃吗？看起来很好。看起来很美味。

content.text: Okay. Very good. And Andrea was worried because many is ordering so much food. She asks, aren't you supposed to be on a diet?
content.trans: 好的。很好，安德里亚因为很多人都在订购食物而担心，她问，你是不是应该节食？

content.text: Okay. So this is a phrase. And I want to remind everyone to keep this phrase in mind. You can, you can diet, which is a verb. But in this case, you're on a diet. So it's a noun. I'm on a diet. I'm trying to eat healthily. I'm trying to watch the things that I put in my body.
content.trans: 好的。这是个短语。我想提醒大家，要记住这个短语。你可以，你也可以减肥，这是一个动词。但在这个情况下，你是减肥的。所以，它是一个名词。我现在在减肥。我正在努力健康地吃。我正在控制自己体内摄入的东西。

content.text: So usually if you're on a diet, you don't eat really greasy, fatty, Chinese, take out Chinese food. You eat salads and soups.
content.trans: 所以通常来说，如果你正在减肥，你就不吃太油腻、脂肪含量高的中国菜。你可以吃凉拌菜和汤类食物。

content.text: Okay. So you are on a diet. Yes, he's on a diet or I was on a diet, but I stopped.
content.trans: 好的。你正在减肥。是的，他也在减肥，或者我也是在减肥，但我停止了。

content.text: All right. A lot of great appealing food. Why don't we go and listen to our dialogue again? And we'll be back with language takeaway part two.
content.trans: 好的。很多令人垂涎的美食。为什么不再次听我们的对话呢？我们会回到第二部分的语言小食。

content.text: But we're going to take a look at the specific American Chinese dishes.
content.trans: 但是我们将要看看美国中文菜式。

content.text: Hi. Welcome to Happy Buddha. Can I get you anything to drink?
content.trans: 你好。欢迎来到幸福佛寺。你能给我点什么吗？

content.text: Coke for me, please. I'll have a sprite. Okay. I'll go get that for you. Are there any questions with the menu?
content.trans: 英语：请给我一瓶可乐，我还需要一个精灵。好的，我会去拿那个给你。有什么问题吗？

content.text: So you use MSG? No, ma'am. We are MSG free.
content.trans: 英语：所以你使用MSG吗？不，太太。我们是MSG 无权使用。

content.text: Oh, man. I haven't had Chinese food in so long. I want everything. This place has the best sesame chicken.
content.trans: 哎呀，好啊。我好久没吃中国菜了。我想吃各种各样的东西。这个地方的 sesame chicken 可以说是最棒的。

content.text: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time. I used to get take out all the time. It's definitely been a while.
content.trans: 是的，我一直对中文情有独钟。我曾经经常去取快递。真是太久了。

content.text: Let's start off with some crab rangoon. Oh, yeah, that sounds good. I think I'm going to get the sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll, and egg drop soup.
content.trans: 让我们从一些蟹粉东星开始。哦，是的，听起来不错。我想我会得到蟹粉小炒、春卷和蛋花汤。

content.text: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu. It all looks so appetizing. I think I'll get general toast chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wantons, and white rice.
content.trans: 这个点和拍是傻瓜相机。SLR/DSLR是单反相机。机身是体，镜头是镜，长焦是长焦，偏振镜是偏振镜。卸下重任是卸下重担。赋予神速是授予神速。一路顺风是疏远且微弱。入门级是入门级。显示屏是显示屏。套机镜头是机。流利构建单元是单元。全球视野是全视野。

content.text: I'm just supposed to be on a diet. You should at least get brown rice. I don't think so. I hate brown rice, and I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
content.trans: 我被要求减肥。你应该至少吃糙米。我不这么认为，我对糙米不感兴趣，而且我讨厌吃健康的一切。

content.text: I've been eating so much salad. I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like. There's no better remedy than some nice greasy calorie-laden Chinese food.
content.trans: 我一直在吃大量的沙拉。我保证，我已经忘记了肉的味道了。没有什么比一些美味的中国油腻食物更好的治疗方式了。

content.text: I might even get an order of broccoli beef. Oh gosh, I'm so hungry. Let's call the waitress over.
content.trans: 我甚至可能得到一份牛肉白菜的订单。哦，天啊，我真饿了。让我们叫服务员过来吧。

content.text: All right, we're back. So now let's take a look at those delicious American Chinese dishes on Language Takeaway Part 2.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经回来。现在让我们来看看Part 2上的那些美味的中美洲中国菜。

content.text: Language Takeaway.
content.trans: 语言总结。

content.text: And so here we are with a number of delicious and very appetizing dishes. These are things that you'll normally find in an American Chinese restaurant.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请将需要翻译的英文内容提供给我吧。

content.text: The first one is called crab rangoon. Okay, so this doesn't sound very Chinese at all.
content.trans: 英语：第一台叫龙虾相机。

content.text: Now, a rangoon is actually a city in a country called Myanmar or Burma. And crab rangoon is a special deep fried dish.
content.trans: 现在，一个拉哥尼亚实际上是一个在缅甸或老挝的国家。而螃蟹拉哥尼亚是一种特别深煎的菜肴。

content.text: That's like, it's like deep fried dumplings, but on the inside there's cream cheese and crab.
content.trans: 这句话可以翻译成中文为：

content.text: Ah, crab meat. That's right.
content.trans: 英语：啊，螃蟹肉。对的。

content.text: All right, so it's kind of as you said, like a dumpling, but inside you have cream cheese and crab.
content.trans: 好的，所以它有点像你所说的，就像一个饺子，但里面你有奶油和螃蟹。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语在中文中的翻译：

content.text: Now, they also talked about getting the sesame chicken with fried rice.
content.trans: 现在，他们还讨论了用炒鸡蛋和米饭来制作松子鸡的问题。

content.text: Okay, so sesame is a very common ingredient in cultures all over the world. And sesame is a kind of seed.
content.trans: 好的，所以芝麻是一种在世界各地文化中非常常见的成分。芝麻也是一种种子。

content.text: But some people also use some sesame oil in their cooking. And so these all come from these white, small seeds.
content.trans: 但是有些人也用一些芝麻油来做菜。而且，这些都来自这些白色的、小的种子。

content.text: And sesame chicken is a kind of chicken that's coated with sesame seeds.
content.trans: 英语：和芝麻鸡是一种用芝麻和香料制成的鸡肉。

content.text: Okay, very good. And obviously we know what fried rice is. You just take, it's just basically rice in a pan.
content.trans: 好的，非常棒。而且很明显，我们都知道炒饭是什么了。你只需要把，它就是基本的米饭在锅里炒。

content.text: With sometimes a little bit of meat and egg and just fry it all together.
content.trans: 有时候，稍微加点肉和鸡蛋，然后一起煎。

content.text: But what about spring rolls? I think these are one of the typical Chinese dishes that everyone knows.
content.trans: 但是，关于春卷呢？我想这些可能是很多人知道的典型中国菜肴。

content.text: And actually it's also, it's a Chinese dish as well.
content.trans: 而且实际上它也是一种中国菜。

content.text: I love spring rolls, although I've never gotten an American spring roll in China.
content.trans: 我爱春卷，尽管从未在中国吃到正宗的春卷。

content.text: The spring rolls we're talking about here are basically wrappers, these like wonton wrappers that are stuffed with meat and vegetables.
content.trans: 这个春卷我们正在讨论的主要是基本的包装，这些像 wonton 包装里塞满了肉和蔬菜。

content.text: They're rolled up, so they look like a long roll and they're deep fried.
content.trans: 他们被卷起来了，所以看起来像一个长条和深煎的。

content.text: So okay, so spring rolls are, as you said, little rolls with meat and sometimes vegetable inside.
content.trans: 所以，嗯，春卷是这样的：馅儿在里面，有时夹着蔬菜。

content.text: Not really sure why they call it spring roll, though.
content.trans: 英语：它不是真的知道为什么叫春卷，不过。

content.text: I don't know either. Maybe it has to do with the ingredients, like their vegetables from the spring.
content.trans: 我也不清楚。或许与食材有关，比如春天的蔬菜。

content.text: Maybe. Now another one that I actually really, really like is this egg drop soup.
content.trans: 英语：也许。现在我真正喜欢的另一款就是这道蛋黄汤圆。

content.text: This is delicious. This is a very simple soup. And when you're cooking it, you break an egg and the egg is mixed into the soup.
content.trans: 这个很好吃。这是一个非常简单的汤。当你烹饪时，你打破一个鸡蛋并将其加入汤中。

content.text: So it looks like it's kind of got these yellow pieces floating, but it's a really nice simple soup with egg.
content.trans: 所以看起来它有点像有这些黄色小块浮在上面，但是一顿饭就很不错了。

content.text: Okay, and that's what it's called egg drop soup.
content.trans: 好的，这就是蛋花汤。

content.text: Now, you mentioned the wonton wrappers and they also mentioned fried wontons. What are wontons?
content.trans: 现在，你提到的 wonton wrappers 和 食用油 也提到了 炸 wontons。炸 wontons 是什么？

content.text: Okay, wontons are also known as hunduan in mainland China, but this is a special kind of dumpling.
content.trans: 好的， wontons 也被称为胡年，在大陆中国称为“胡年”。

content.text: It's got a piece of dough, basically this flattened out, and inside there's meat, maybe some vegetables.
content.trans: 它有块面团，基本已经塌陷了，里面可能还有些蔬菜。

content.text: And sometimes you eat it in soup, but here we're talking about fried wontons, deep fried wontons.
content.trans: 英语：有时你吃它像汤，但这里我们说的是油炸圆饼，深油炸圆饼。

content.text: So you put them in the deep fryer and they're fried so that they're crunchy and the insides are soft.
content.trans: 所以你把它们放进油锅里，炸得那么脆，里面的肉都软了。

content.text: Actually, this is one of my favorite dishes, the original one in China, though as you said the hunduan, because it's like in a soup.
content.trans: 实际上，这是一道我最喜欢的菜肴之一，原汁原味的中国菜，虽然你提到的胡椒粉是亚洲的，但我觉得它就像在汤里一样。

content.text: Yes. And it's very simple, but you have like dumplings in a soup, but the fried ones are also very, very good.
content.trans: 是的。而且它非常简单，但你就像炒菜一样，但煎的比煎的还要好。

content.text: They are both delicious and this is making me very hungry, so maybe we should listen to our dialogue again.
content.trans: 英语：它们都是美味的，这让我非常饿，或许我们可以再听一下我们的对话。

content.text: Hi, welcome to Happy Buddha. Can I get you anything to drink?
content.trans: 你好，欢迎来到幸福的佛。你能为我做点什么吗？

content.text: Coke for me please. I'll have a sprite. Okay, I'll go get that for you. Are there any questions with the menu?
content.trans: 请给我一瓶可乐。我将有一只精灵。好的，我会去拿那瓶给你。菜单上有任何问题吗？

content.text: So you use MSG? No, ma'am, we are MSG free.
content.trans: 英语：所以你用MSG吗？不，太太，我们是MSG 无权使用。

content.text: Oh man, I haven't had Chinese food in so long I want everything. This place has the best sesame chicken.
content.trans: 哎呀，我好久没吃中国菜了，我想吃什么都行。这家店的芝麻鸡最好吃了。

content.text: Yeah, I've been craving Chinese for such a long time. I used to get take out all the time. It's definitely been a while.
content.trans: 是的，我一直对中文情有独钟。我曾经经常去取快递。真是太久了。

content.text: Let's start off with some crab brain gunt. Oh yeah, that sounds good. I think I'm going to get the sesame chicken with fried rice, a spring roll, and egg drop soup.
content.trans: 让我们先从一些基础的烹饪技巧开始。嗯，听起来不错。我想我会得到沙拉虾、炒饭和鸡蛋汤。

content.text: It's so tempting to order everything on the menu. It all looks so appetizing. I think I'll get general toes chicken, hot and sour soup, fried wontons, and white rice.
content.trans: 这个点和拍是傻瓜相机。SLR/DSLR是单反相机。机身是体，镜头是镜，长焦是长焦，偏振镜是偏振镜。卸下重任是卸下任务。赋予神速是授予/给予。一路顺风是疏远且微弱。松开责任是卸任。辞职信是辞职信。入门级是入门级。显示屏是显示屏。套机镜头是机，Fluency Builder是流利构建单元。全球视野是全视野。

content.text: I'm just supposed to be on a diet. You should at least get brown rice. I don't think so. I hate brown rice, and I'm so sick of eating healthy all the time.
content.trans: 我被要求减肥。你应该至少吃糙米。我不这么认为，我对糙米不感兴趣，而且我讨厌吃健康的东西一直都在吃。

content.text: I've been eating so much salad. I swear I've forgotten what meat tastes like. There's no better remedy than some nice greasy calorie-laden Chinese food. I might even get in order of broccoli beef.
content.trans: 我一直在吃大量的沙拉。我保证我已经忘记了肉的味道了。没有什么比一些油腻的、高热量的中式食物更好的治疗方案了。说不定还能得到一盘新鲜的菠菜牛肉呢。

content.text: Oh gosh, I'm so hungry. Let's call the waitress over.
content.trans: 哎呀，我太饿了。让我们叫服务员过来。

content.text: Alright, we're back. As we mentioned, these dishes are very much... I have a certain American influence to them. And they're not really spicy. I think that's the main difference as well.
content.trans: 好的，我们已经回到这里。我们之前提到的这些菜肴非常地道。它们并不辣，我认为这也是主要的区别之一。

content.text: That American Chinese food doesn't really have the intense garlic flavor nor is it spicy like usual Chinese food.
content.trans: 这个美国中式食物并不像通常的中国菜那样有强烈的蒜味，也不辣。

content.text: That's right. So I think that part of that is like I said due to the fact that a lot of the Chinese Americans who first came over came from Hong Kong, and so Hong Kong food is not as famous for its spiciness. It's not like Sichuan food.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。所以我认为那部分与我所说的相似之处在于，许多刚来中国的中国人来自香港，所以香港的食物并不像四川食物那样辣。

content.text: You will see a lot of sweet sauces. This general sauce chicken is like a very, very sweet sauce.
content.trans: 你将会看到很多甜点。这道鸡肉是像非常甜的那样。

content.text: We also see a lot of soy sauce in American Chinese cooking. These are flavors that are very, very strong, and they're not the same as the Chinese peppers and these spicy foods you get in China.
content.trans: 我们还看到很多香醋在美国中式烹饪中。这些味道非常强烈，与中国的辣椒和辛辣食物完全不同。

content.text: That's right. Actually, there's one more dish that we didn't mention in the dialogue, actually, but it's very famous all around the United States. It's called Chapsui.
content.trans: 是的，你说得对。实际上，在对话中我们没有提到其他一个重要的项目，但它非常著名，整个美国都为之自豪。它是Chapstick。

content.text: Many people have argued about where the name comes from. But Chapsui is basically like everything chopped up and fried together.
content.trans: 英语：许多人争论了名字的来源。但Chapsui基本上就像一切都混合在一起一样。

content.text: It's like stir-fried vegetables and meat, and now put together in just a bowl.
content.trans: 英语：它就像炒菜和肉，现在就一起做成一个碗。

content.text: My favorite thing about the American Chinese food that we get is that we get it in these little boxes. They're very cute.
content.trans: 我的最爱是美国中餐，我们经常收到这些小盒子。它们非常可爱。

content.text: When you take them home and you open them up, and every food has a box. At the end, you also get a fortune cookie, which is a very small cookie.
content.trans: 当您将它们带到家里并打开它们，然后每样食物都有一盒。最后，您还会收到一个幸运符，这是一个非常小的幸运符。

content.text: Inside, there's a piece of paper. Don't eat the paper. The paper has a fortune for you. It says, you will be very lucky today. Your favorite number is 17.
content.trans: 里面有一个小纸片。不要吃纸。纸有好运给你，你今天会很幸运。你的最爱数字是17。

content.text: They're very cute.
content.trans: 他们很可爱。

content.text: Actually, you can see these boxes that the Catherine mentions on our lesson page. It's the lesson photo.
content.trans: 实际上，你可以在我们的课程页面上看到这些盒子，它们是我们在课程照片上的内容。

content.text: As you said, very, very common. Each dish is put in this little box. If you ever get Chinese food, you'll see people carrying these little boxes around.
content.trans: 英语：当你提到，非常普遍。每盘菜都装在一个小盒子里。如果你经常吃中国菜，你就会看到这些小盒子四处飘荡。

content.text: Because they're very convenient and easy to carry. But the fortune cookie thing is also very common.
content.trans: 因为它们非常方便且容易携带。但福字这个东西也是很常见的。

content.text: I was actually very surprised when I went to China and there were no fortune cookies.
content.trans: 英语：我实际上非常惊讶，当我去中国时，没有福卡。

content.text: It's weird, isn't it? I think it's funny because we expect these things to be very Chinese.
content.trans: 英语：它很奇怪，不是吗？我认为这很有趣，因为我们期望这些东西会非常中国。

content.text: But in fact, when you come to mainland China, they don't have fortune cookies. I think it's a nice surprise, but also kind of confusing.
content.trans: 但是实际上，在大陆中国，他们并没有福卡。我觉得这是一次不错的惊喜，但也有些许的困惑。

content.text: That's right. Well, a very interesting topic. In the future, we're going to continue doing different lessons about different cuisines.
content.trans: 是的。很好，这是一个很有趣的主题。在未来，我们将继续学习不同菜肴的不同课程。

content.text: We have Italian food coming up sometime soon. That's going to be very good as well.
content.trans: 我们很快就会有意大利菜。那会儿肯定很好吃。

content.text: Of course, if you have any lesson suggestions or maybe you want to suggest the cuisine from your country, you can visit our website, www.englishpot.com.
content.trans: 当然，如果您有任何建议或想要分享您国家的美食，请访问我们的网站：www.englishpot.com。

content.text: We hope to see you guys there. Until next time. Bye.
content.trans: 我们希望你们能见到你。下一次见。再见。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
